fact: INSTAT's Mali en chiffres, edition 2024 (June 2026), tabulates 2020-2024 figures drawn from health facility data (Annuaire SNISS 2020-2024), school returns (CPS/SE Bulletin statistique DGESRS 2020-2024), customs-based foreign trade statistics (Statistiques du commerce extérieur 2024, INSTAT), the state budget (DGB Budget citoyen), and CNDIFE, DNPIA and EDM-SA records.
title: Mali en chiffres, édition 2024
